analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of docs.cypress.io covered 315 pages crawled from 1,293 discovered pages with 100% crawl coverage within scope. Link integrity is strong with only 2 confirmed broken internal documentation links and zero broken repository links. API reference coverage is critically low at 15.19% despite detecting 165 API pages, indicating significant gaps in usage documentation. Example reliability stands at 87.19% with 99.05% of pages showing last-updated metadata. Overall audit confidence is 91.5% with API coverage confidence at 85%.
strengths: Excellent link integrity: only 2 broken internal documentation links across 315 crawled pages
Complete crawl coverage at 100% within defined scope (1,293 pages)
Strong freshness tracking with 99.05% last-updated metadata coverage
risks: Critical API coverage gap: only 15.19% of 165 detected API pages have adequate usage documentation
SEO/geo issue rate at 7.62% may impact discoverability in certain markets
2 confirmed broken internal documentation links require immediate remediation
Large discovery-to-crawl gap (1,293 discovered vs 315 crawled) suggests potential scope limitations or access restrictions
API confidence at 85% indicates possible detection or measurement limitations in coverage calculation
12.81% of examples may be unreliable or outdated
138 excluded links warrant review to ensure no critical resources are being systematically ignored

prioritized_actions.action: Expand API usage documentation to cover the 140+ API pages lacking adequate examples and integration guidance
Fix 2 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Investigate and resolve SEO/geo issues affecting 7.62% of pages to improve international discoverability
Review and update the 12.81% of examples flagged as potentially unreliable
Audit the 138 excluded links to verify no critical documentation resources are being systematically omitted

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical content, code examples, or API specifications
Crawl covered 315 of 1,293 discovered pages; uncrawled pages may contain additional issues not reflected in this analysis
API coverage detection at 85% confidence suggests measurement methodology may not capture all API documentation patterns
Cannot assess user comprehension, documentation effectiveness, or whether content meets actual developer needs
Link checking reflects point-in-time status; dynamic content or authentication-gated resources may not be fully validated
